verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows INPI Portugal offers online services, such as requesting a title online and a guide to filing trademark and logo applications online. Nothing in it says whether a founder can start the core online filing flow without first creating an account, or describes a keyless or file-number entry path. The axis is fair for an IP office's online filing service, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
